verdict.rationale: Smithery documents a Triggers mechanism: MCP servers surface upstream events, consumers activate a trigger through Smithery, and events are POSTed straight to the consumer, with trigger schemas included in the generated SDK. This provides event subscription only. Defining rules that automatically fire actions is left to the consumer's own code, and Smithery is explicitly not in the delivery path. Missing for 10: a user-definable rule/condition engine, automatic action execution on events, and any hands-on or independent corroboration of triggers working.
